description:
Cloud-neutral PDF-to-text extraction on Apache PDFBox 3. PdfTextExtract.extract
        turns PDF bytes into text and never throws an exception: it returns null for a PDF with no
        text layer, and for corrupt, password-protected or unparseable input, so a
        caller working through millions of documents records "no text" and moves on.
        Depends only on PDFBox and slf4j-api, so it runs inside a Beam or Dataflow
        worker as well as in an application. Issue #275.
